7th Grade · Unit 1 · Appearance and Personality

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert's grandfather has no hair on the top of his head. His head is smooth in that area. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) bald

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert's grandfather has no hair on the top of his head. His head is smooth in that area.” Bu tarif “bald” kelimesine uyar; bald = kel. Diğer şıklar: dark hair (koyu renk saç), middle-aged (orta yaşlı), straight (düz).

2

Ece's hair is very light and golden in colour. It is not brown, black or red. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) blond

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece's hair is very light and golden in colour. It is not brown, black or red.” Bu tarif “blond” kelimesine uyar; blond = sarışın. Diğer şıklar: wear glasses (gözlük takmak), tall (uzun boylu), young (genç).

3

Selin's hair forms many small curls. It does not fall in straight lines or loose waves. Her hair is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) curly

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin's hair forms many small curls. It does not fall in straight lines or loose waves.” Bu tarif “curly” kelimesine uyar; curly = kıvırcık. Diğer şıklar: old (yaşlı), weight (kilo, ağırlık), height (boy, yükseklik).

4

Bora's hair falls in smooth lines. It has no curls or waves. His hair is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) straight

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora's hair falls in smooth lines. It has no curls or waves.” Bu tarif “straight” kelimesine uyar; straight = düz. Diğer şıklar: headscarf (baş örtüsü), plump (tombul, balık etli), hazel (ela).

5

Duru's hair has loose bends like waves. It is neither completely straight nor tightly curly. Her hair is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) wavy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru's hair has loose bends like waves. It is neither completely straight nor tightly curly.” Bu tarif “wavy” kelimesine uyar; wavy = dalgalı. Diğer şıklar: freckle (çil), slim (ince, zayıf), well-built (kaslı, yapılı).

6

Arda is much higher than most of his classmates when they stand together. He can easily reach the top shelf. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) tall

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda is much higher than most of his classmates when they stand together. He can easily reach the top shelf.” Bu tarif “tall” kelimesine uyar; tall = uzun boylu. Diğer şıklar: plump (tombul, balık etli), headscarf (baş örtüsü), wear glasses (gözlük takmak).

7

Elif is lower in height than most of her classmates. She stands at the front for class photos so everyone can see her. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) short

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif is lower in height than most of her classmates. She stands at the front for class photos so everyone can see her.” Bu tarif “short” kelimesine uyar; short = kısa boylu. Diğer şıklar: hazel (ela), freckle (çil), young (genç).

8

Can has a narrow, lean body. He is neither plump nor heavily built. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) slim

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can has a narrow, lean body. He is neither plump nor heavily built.” Bu tarif “slim” kelimesine uyar; slim = ince, zayıf. Diğer şıklar: dark hair (koyu renk saç), wavy (dalgalı), old (yaşlı).

9

Nehir describes a character in her story. The character has a full, rounded body rather than a slim one. The character is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) plump

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir describes a character in her story. The character has a full, rounded body rather than a slim one.” Bu tarif “plump” kelimesine uyar; plump = tombul, balık etli. Diğer şıklar: middle-aged (orta yaşlı), blond (sarışın), weight (kilo, ağırlık).

10

Emir trains regularly and has strong muscles. His shoulders are broad, and his body looks powerful. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) well-built

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir trains regularly and has strong muscles. His shoulders are broad, and his body looks powerful.” Bu tarif “well-built” kelimesine uyar; well-built = kaslı, yapılı. Diğer şıklar: height (boy, yükseklik), bald (kel), curly (kıvırcık).

11

Sena's cousin is only six years old. She is a child and has many years ahead of her. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) young

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena's cousin is only six years old. She is a child and has many years ahead of her.” Bu tarif “young” kelimesine uyar; young = genç. Diğer şıklar: short (kısa boylu), freckle (çil), blond (sarışın).

12

Baran's uncle is forty-eight years old. He is an adult between early adulthood and old age. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) middle-aged

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran's uncle is forty-eight years old. He is an adult between early adulthood and old age.” Bu tarif “middle-aged” kelimesine uyar; middle-aged = orta yaşlı. Diğer şıklar: straight (düz), wear glasses (gözlük takmak), curly (kıvırcık).

13

İpek's great-grandmother is ninety-two. Her family describes her as an elderly person. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) old

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek's great-grandmother is ninety-two. Her family describes her as an elderly person.” Bu tarif “old” kelimesine uyar; old = yaşlı. Diğer şıklar: tall (uzun boylu), weight (kilo, ağırlık), bald (kel).

14

Tolga's aunt puts a piece of cloth over her hair. She wears it on her head when she goes out. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) headscarf

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga's aunt puts a piece of cloth over her hair. She wears it on her head when she goes out.” Bu tarif “headscarf” kelimesine uyar; headscarf = baş örtüsü. Diğer şıklar: dark hair (koyu renk saç), height (boy, yükseklik), wavy (dalgalı).

15

Eylül has a small brown spot on her cheek. It is a natural mark on her skin. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) freckle

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül has a small brown spot on her cheek. It is a natural mark on her skin.” Bu tarif “freckle” kelimesine uyar; freckle = çil. Diğer şıklar: well-built (kaslı, yapılı), short (kısa boylu), slim (ince, zayıf).

16

Ozan's eyes have a mixture of brown and green colouring. They are not simply blue or dark brown. His eye colour is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) hazel

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan's eyes have a mixture of brown and green colouring. They are not simply blue or dark brown.” Bu tarif “hazel” kelimesine uyar; hazel = ela. Diğer şıklar: tall (uzun boylu), wavy (dalgalı), young (genç).

17

Cemre stands next to a measuring chart. The chart shows the distance from her feet to the top of her head. It measures her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) height

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre stands next to a measuring chart. The chart shows the distance from her feet to the top of her head.” Bu tarif “height” kelimesine uyar; height = boy, yükseklik. Diğer şıklar: bald (kel), blond (sarışın), straight (düz).

18

Yusuf stands on a set of scales. The number tells him how heavy he is in kilograms. It shows his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) weight

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf stands on a set of scales. The number tells him how heavy he is in kilograms.” Bu tarif “weight” kelimesine uyar; weight = kilo, ağırlık. Diğer şıklar: old (yaşlı), slim (ince, zayıf), middle-aged (orta yaşlı).

19

Melis has trouble seeing the board clearly. She uses a pair of lenses in a frame in front of her eyes. She needs to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) wear glasses

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis has trouble seeing the board clearly. She uses a pair of lenses in a frame in front of her eyes.” Bu tarif “wear glasses” kelimesine uyar; wear glasses = gözlük takmak. Diğer şıklar: plump (tombul, balık etli), curly (kıvırcık), well-built (kaslı, yapılı).

20

Aras's hair is almost black. It is much deeper in colour than fair or blond hair. He has ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) dark hair

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras's hair is almost black. It is much deeper in colour than fair or blond hair.” Bu tarif “dark hair” kelimesine uyar; dark hair = koyu renk saç. Diğer şıklar: short (kısa boylu), hazel (ela), headscarf (baş örtüsü).

21

Sıla usually smiles and enjoys her day. Her happy mood makes people around her feel good. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) cheerful

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla usually smiles and enjoys her day. Her happy mood makes people around her feel good.” Bu tarif “cheerful” kelimesine uyar; cheerful = neşeli. Diğer şıklar: lazy (tembel), funny (eğlenceli, komik), rude (kaba).

22

Gökçe often drops things by accident. She knocks over cups and bumps into furniture. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) clumsy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe often drops things by accident. She knocks over cups and bumps into furniture.” Bu tarif “clumsy” kelimesine uyar; clumsy = sakar. Diğer şıklar: generous (cömert), tidy (düzenli), talkative (konuşkan, geveze).

23

Defne does not get upset about small changes in plans. She accepts new ideas and stays calm. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) easy-going

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne does not get upset about small changes in plans. She accepts new ideas and stays calm.” Bu tarif “easy-going” kelimesine uyar; easy-going = uysal, aldırış etmeyen. Diğer şıklar: kind (nazik, kibar), successful (başarılı), thoughtful (düşünceli).

24

Kerem tells amusing stories at lunch. His jokes make everyone laugh. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) funny

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem tells amusing stories at lunch. His jokes make everyone laugh.” Bu tarif “funny” kelimesine uyar; funny = eğlenceli, komik. Diğer şıklar: shy (çekingen, utangaç), outgoing (dışa dönük, girişken), hardworking (çalışkan).

25

Buse enjoys giving things to others. She often buys small gifts and shares what she has without expecting anything back. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) generous

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse enjoys giving things to others. She often buys small gifts and shares what she has without expecting anything back.” Bu tarif “generous” kelimesine uyar; generous = cömert. Diğer şıklar: stubborn (inatçı), honest (dürüst), punctual (dakik).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Deniz finds some money in the classroom. He gives it to the teacher and tells the truth about where he finds it. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) honest

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz finds some money in the classroom. He gives it to the teacher and tells the truth about where he finds it.” Bu tarif “honest” kelimesine uyar; honest = dürüst. Diğer şıklar: selfish (bencil), hardworking (çalışkan), rude (kaba).

2

İdil treats other people gently and cares about their feelings. She helps a new student feel welcome. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) kind

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil treats other people gently and cares about their feelings. She helps a new student feel welcome.” Bu tarif “kind” kelimesine uyar; kind = nazik, kibar. Diğer şıklar: stubborn (inatçı), clumsy (sakar), lazy (tembel).

3

Onur worries before speaking in front of the class. His hands shake, and he feels uneasy. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) nervous

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur worries before speaking in front of the class. His hands shake, and he feels uneasy.” Bu tarif “nervous” kelimesine uyar; nervous = gergin, tedirgin. Diğer şıklar: generous (cömert), easy-going (uysal, aldırış etmeyen), tidy (düzenli).

4

Zeynep enjoys meeting new people. She starts conversations easily and likes being with others. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) outgoing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep enjoys meeting new people. She starts conversations easily and likes being with others.” Bu tarif “outgoing” kelimesine uyar; outgoing = dışa dönük, girişken. Diğer şıklar: funny (eğlenceli, komik), talkative (konuşkan, geveze), successful (başarılı).

5

Arda checks the time before every appointment. He never keeps people waiting and arrives exactly when he should. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) punctual

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda checks the time before every appointment. He never keeps people waiting and arrives exactly when he should.” Bu tarif “punctual” kelimesine uyar; punctual = dakik. Diğer şıklar: shy (çekingen, utangaç), cheerful (neşeli), thoughtful (düşünceli).

6

Mina interrupts people and speaks disrespectfully. She does not care if her words hurt others. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) rude

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina interrupts people and speaks disrespectfully. She does not care if her words hurt others.” Bu tarif “rude” kelimesine uyar; rude = kaba. Diğer şıklar: lazy (tembel), clumsy (sakar), hardworking (çalışkan).

7

Ali thinks only about his own wishes. He keeps everything for himself and ignores what others need. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) selfish

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali thinks only about his own wishes. He keeps everything for himself and ignores what others need.” Bu tarif “selfish” kelimesine uyar; selfish = bencil. Diğer şıklar: generous (cömert), tidy (düzenli), cheerful (neşeli).

8

Pelin feels uncomfortable with new people. She speaks very little and avoids starting conversations. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) shy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin feels uncomfortable with new people. She speaks very little and avoids starting conversations.” Bu tarif “shy” kelimesine uyar; shy = çekingen, utangaç. Diğer şıklar: thoughtful (düşünceli), outgoing (dışa dönük, girişken), punctual (dakik).

9

Efe refuses to change his mind. Even when others give good reasons, he insists on his own idea. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) stubborn

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe refuses to change his mind. Even when others give good reasons, he insists on his own idea.” Bu tarif “stubborn” kelimesine uyar; stubborn = inatçı. Diğer şıklar: nervous (gergin, tedirgin), easy-going (uysal, aldırış etmeyen), funny (eğlenceli, komik).

10

Derya sets goals and achieves them. Her projects win prizes, and her work brings good results. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) successful

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya sets goals and achieves them. Her projects win prizes, and her work brings good results.” Bu tarif “successful” kelimesine uyar; successful = başarılı. Diğer şıklar: kind (nazik, kibar), honest (dürüst), shy (çekingen, utangaç).

11

Berk always has something to say. He speaks for a long time and enjoys long conversations. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) talkative

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk always has something to say. He speaks for a long time and enjoys long conversations.” Bu tarif “talkative” kelimesine uyar; talkative = konuşkan, geveze. Diğer şıklar: funny (eğlenceli, komik), hardworking (çalışkan), cheerful (neşeli).

12

Sena notices that her friend feels lonely. She plans a small surprise to make her feel better. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) thoughtful

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena notices that her friend feels lonely. She plans a small surprise to make her feel better.” Bu tarif “thoughtful” kelimesine uyar; thoughtful = düşünceli. Diğer şıklar: rude (kaba), lazy (tembel), outgoing (dışa dönük, girişken).

13

Burak keeps his books in order. His desk is neat, and everything is in its proper place. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) tidy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak keeps his books in order. His desk is neat, and everything is in its proper place.” Bu tarif “tidy” kelimesine uyar; tidy = düzenli. Diğer şıklar: stubborn (inatçı), nervous (gergin, tedirgin), talkative (konuşkan, geveze).

14

Eda puts a lot of effort into her studies. She completes every task carefully and studies regularly. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) hardworking

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda puts a lot of effort into her studies. She completes every task carefully and studies regularly.” Bu tarif “hardworking” kelimesine uyar; hardworking = çalışkan. Diğer şıklar: kind (nazik, kibar), generous (cömert), punctual (dakik).

15

Tuna avoids tasks even when he has plenty of time. He prefers doing nothing and does not make an effort. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) lazy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna avoids tasks even when he has plenty of time. He prefers doing nothing and does not make an effort.” Bu tarif “lazy” kelimesine uyar; lazy = tembel. Diğer şıklar: clumsy (sakar), honest (dürüst), selfish (bencil).

16

Cem loves reading more than almost any other activity. He always carries a book and reads in his free time. He is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) bookworm

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem loves reading more than almost any other activity. He always carries a book and reads in his free time.” Bu tarif “bookworm” kelimesine uyar; bookworm = kitap kurdu. Diğer şıklar: truth (gerçek), celebrity (ünlü), twin (ikiz).

17

Aylin describes her cousin's hair, eyes and height. She talks about how her cousin looks rather than how she behaves. She describes her cousin's ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) appearance

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin describes her cousin's hair, eyes and height. She talks about how her cousin looks rather than how she behaves.” Bu tarif “appearance” kelimesine uyar; appearance = görünüş. Diğer şıklar: lie (yalan), joke (şaka), trait (özellik).

18

Eren describes his friend as honest and cheerful. He talks about the way his friend thinks and behaves. He describes his friend's ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) personality

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren describes his friend as honest and cheerful. He talks about the way his friend thinks and behaves.” Bu tarif “personality” kelimesine uyar; personality = kişilik. Diğer şıklar: classmate (sınıf arkadaşı), present (hediye), relationship (ilişki).

19

Nehir looks at two people in a photo. She checks how their hair and height are alike or different. She wants to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) compare

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir looks at two people in a photo. She checks how their hair and height are alike or different.” Bu tarif “compare” kelimesine uyar; compare = karşılaştırmak. Diğer şıklar: share (paylaşmak), arrive (varmak), meet friends (arkadaşlarla buluşmak).

20

Baran tells a friend what his cousin looks like. He gives details about her hair, eyes and face. He wants to ______ his cousin.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) describe

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran tells a friend what his cousin looks like. He gives details about her hair, eyes and face.” Bu tarif “describe” kelimesine uyar; describe = betimlemek, tasvir etmek. Diğer şıklar: smile (gülümsemek), care (önemsemek, ilgilenmek), support (desteklemek).

21

İpek and her sister enjoy spending time together. They understand and support each other and rarely argue. They ______ with each other.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) get on well

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek and her sister enjoy spending time together. They understand and support each other and rarely argue.” Bu tarif “get on well” kelimesine uyar; get on well = iyi geçinmek. Diğer şıklar: forget (unutmak), change (değiştirmek), share (paylaşmak).

22

Tolga and his friend both enjoy cycling and chess. They also like the same books. They have several interests ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) in common

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga and his friend both enjoy cycling and chess. They also like the same books.” Bu tarif “in common” kelimesine uyar; in common = ortak. Diğer şıklar: easily (kolayca), alone (yalnız), different (farklı).

23

Eylül's appointment starts at ten o'clock. She arrives at ten, exactly when she should. She arrives ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) on time

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül's appointment starts at ten o'clock. She arrives at ten, exactly when she should.” Bu tarif “on time” kelimesine uyar; on time = zamanında. Diğer şıklar: late (geç), patiently (sabırla), same (aynı).

24

Ozan has a large box of crayons. He lets his classmates use them too. He likes to ______ his crayons.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) share

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan has a large box of crayons. He lets his classmates use them too.” Bu tarif “share” kelimesine uyar; share = paylaşmak. Diğer şıklar: support (desteklemek), meet friends (arkadaşlarla buluşmak), care (önemsemek, ilgilenmek).

25

Cemre and her brother have the same birthday. They are born to the same mother on the same day. Each child is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) twin

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre and her brother have the same birthday. They are born to the same mother on the same day.” Bu tarif “twin” kelimesine uyar; twin = ikiz. Diğer şıklar: relationship (ilişki), classmate (sınıf arkadaşı), celebrity (ünlü).

Vocabulary Test 2 · Sonuç

✔ Doğru: 0✘ Yanlış: 0○ Boş: 0

Her soru 4 puan. Yanlış ya da boş bir soruya tıkla; o soruya gidip doğrusunu ve Türkçe çözümünü gör.

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

bald

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) kel

“bald” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “kel” olur. Bu ifade “Fiziksel görünüş” grubundandır. Örnek: My grandfather is bald.

2

blond

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) sarışın

“blond” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “sarışın” olur. Bu ifade “Fiziksel görünüş” grubundandır. Örnek: She has got blond hair.

3

curly

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) kıvırcık

“curly” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “kıvırcık” olur. Bu ifade “Fiziksel görünüş” grubundandır. Örnek: Ece has got curly hair.

4

straight

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) düz

“straight” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “düz” olur. Bu ifade “Fiziksel görünüş” grubundandır. Örnek: He has got short straight hair.

5

wavy

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) dalgalı

“wavy” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “dalgalı” olur. Bu ifade “Fiziksel görünüş” grubundandır. Örnek: My mother has got wavy hair.

6

tall

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) uzun boylu

“tall” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “uzun boylu” olur. Bu ifade “Fiziksel görünüş” grubundandır. Örnek: My brother is very tall.

7

short

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) kısa boylu

“short” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “kısa boylu” olur. Bu ifade “Fiziksel görünüş” grubundandır. Örnek: My sister is short.
